shortDescription: The Baltic Exchange's dry bulk freight index, which tracks rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, fell on Thursday, hurt by weaker rates across larger segments.

children: The Baltic Exchange's dry bulk freight index, which tracks rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, fell on Thursday, hurt by weaker rates across larger segments.
, which tracks rates for capesize, panamax and supramax vessels, fell 99 points, or 2.7%, to 3,521.
The capesize index (.BACI) was down 278 points, or 4.3%, at 6,122.
Average daily earnings for capesize vessels (.BATCA), which typically transport 150,000-ton cargoes, including iron ore and coal, decreased by $2,522 to $52,016.
Iron ore prices slid for a second straight session to hit their lowest level in nearly a week, dragged down by concerns over falling demand in top consumer China as steel margins shrink.
The panamax index (.BPNI) fell 5 points, or 0.2%, at 2,409.
Average daily earnings for panamax vessels (.BPWT), which usually carry 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, fell $41 to $21,684.
The supramax index (.BSIS) was up 9 points, or 0.5%, at 1,713.
